svg.title: E40b vs the lagged nulls, per fire
svg.desc: Small multiples, one bar chart per fire: mean consensus IoU over the windows with a lagged null (k >= 1), for E33 (no state correction), E40 (20% of the population state-corrected), E40b (everyone state-corrected), lagged persistence (yesterday's mask, unchanged) and the lagged Circle (yesterday's mask, grown to today's true area) -- the two dummy competitors that see exactly what state correction sees and no more. Every fire's ensemble configuration loses to both lagged nulls.
svg.text: MEAN CONSENSUS IOU OVER k >= 1 (COMPARABLE TO THE LAGGED NULLS), PER FIRE
